secondary_metrics: at least one valid reviewer-negative result within ten attempts
notes: Exactly two benchmarks and three feedback conditions; no additional experimental arm.
Twenty attempts per circuit/condition/run, organized as two ten-attempt trajectories. None is fresh independent generation at every attempt.
Within each circuit/start the first candidate and its review are shared across the three arms. Subsequent binary/full requests see their own immediately preceding candidate.
Binary receives only the preceding Boolean verdict; full receives the complete preceding reviewer JSON. No simulator results are sent to any attacker.
The netlist-only reviewer is the explicitly permitted minimal implementation in the execution plan; it is not full SPICED.
Bounded JSON circuit edits use an offline electrically qualified Cartesian template space. Every generated candidate is simulated again and failures remain in the denominator.
Both run identifiers and seeds are fixed before the first review. The second run is an independent API replication of the same protocol, not cached reuse.
No early stopping on success and no tuning to require none < binary < full. Rates are descriptive; adaptive attempts are not IID.
